I didn't touch screen 41, so it can't be lower. I didn't run the 1080p pictures for the two hub backpack screens this time; the earlier run took one for 41 with no change. The fresh picture is in `tools/handoff/console/notes/shots/115-after3`. The best version is v34.66, and the notes in `tools/handoff/console/notes/115-ui-raid-backpack.md` are updated.
